name_en: Kamasu zushi — salt-cured barracuda pressed around vinegared rice for an autumn shrine festival
summary_ja: 塩じめしたカマスを甘酢につけ、すし飯を詰めて成形する。久留米の高良山くんちの参道で栗入り赤飯とともに売られてきたとされ、奉納に使う叺（かます）と魚の語呂合わせが名の由来という。
summary_en: Salt-cured barracuda is steeped in sweet vinegar and pressed around sushi rice — long sold alongside chestnut rice along the approach to Kurume's Kora-san shrine festival, its name said to play on a straw sack called 'kamasu', once filled with rice for offering.
source_title: かます寿司 福岡県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
